business_summary: DCM Nouvelle Limited engages in the manufacturing and sale of cotton yarn in in India, Bangladesh, China, Guatemala, Egypt, and internationally. The company offers combed, carded, compact, and double yarns, as well as better cotton initiative, organic, and slub yarns under the FUTURO, PRIMERO, DINERO, and CCY brand names. It also provides benzylamine and dibenzylamine products for various processes in pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, rubber chemicals, oils, and polymers industries. In addition, the company exports its products. DCM Nouvelle Limited was founded in 1991 and is based in New Delhi, India.
